_meta.purpose: Robustness audit of the 3-layer KG (semantic + kinetic + dynamic) against dev + governance use-cases. Read-only audit; remediation PRs filed separately. Per user directive 2026-05-16: 'make sure our knowledge graph is robust enough to support our development and governance.'

gaps: no node_type for ChangeSet → PR → audit-chain-row provenance chain
action_invoked rows captured but no aggregate read-side query joins them across autonomy_tier hierarchy

findings.summary: ComplianceControl → SatisfiedByLane → EvidencePath chain is graph-declared; compliance-attestation 100%
findings.remediation: Closed by registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json node_types ComplianceControl/SatisfiedByLane/EvidencePath, edge_types satisfied_by_lane/evidence_path, invariant I15, and read-side query show_compliance_evidence_freshness.

findings.summary: Incident → CausedByChange → PullRequest chain is graph-declared and emitted by CloseIncident.
findings.remediation: Closed by registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json node_types Incident/CausedByChange/PullRequest, edge_types caused_by_change/change_from_pr, invariant I16, read-side query trace_incident_root_cause_prs, and kinetic action CloseIncident.

findings.summary: Blast-radius inference has read-side graph traversal aligned to deterministic review_tiering signals.
findings.remediation: Closed by registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json read_side_query_examples/reachable_entity_types_for_diff, which maps candidate diff files to reachable entity types, downstream consumers, and blast_radius_score signal evidence.

findings.summary: AgentDecision is graph-declared with caused_by decision-chain traversal.
findings.remediation: Closed by registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json node_type AgentDecision, edge_type caused_by, invariant I17, and read-side query trace_agent_decision_chain.

findings.summary: AcceptanceCriterion → Test → CILaneRun chain is graph-declared.
findings.remediation: Closed by registry/knowledge-graph-semantic.json node_types AcceptanceCriterion/Test/CILaneRun, edge_types covered_by_test/executed_by_ci_lane, invariant I18, and read-side query trace_acceptance_test_ci_chain.

findings.summary: ChangeSet → PR → audit-chain-row provenance implicit via PR number, not graph edge

verdict_per_use_case.rationale: Compliance controls now traverse to lane satisfaction and evidence paths through semantic KG edge types plus read-side freshness query.
Closed incidents now traverse mechanically to root-cause change nodes and PullRequest nodes, and CloseIncident declares audit-topic emission plus validator recheck of I16.
Candidate diff files can now be joined to KG nodes, downstream graph edges, deterministic blast_radius_score signals, and downstream consumers before review dispatch.
Agent decisions are now graph nodes with recursive caused_by traversal and evidence refs.

overall_verdict.robust_enough_for_development: YES (3-layer architecture sound; 6 gaps identified; all remediation additive — node/edge_type additions, no schema breaking change)
overall_verdict.robust_enough_for_governance: YES (F-KG-01 compliance-attestation, F-KG-02 incident root-cause traversal, F-KG-03 blast-radius traversal, F-KG-04 agent decision provenance, and F-KG-05 acceptance/test/CI traceability resolved; remaining finding is ChangeSet/PR/audit-row provenance)
overall_verdict.recommendation: F-KG-01 through F-KG-05 are closed. Continue with F-KG-06 (ChangeSet/PR/audit-row provenance chain) opportunistic.
overall_verdict.doctrine_pointer: $ref:specs/agent-durable-goal.json#autonomous_foundry.lane_promotion_protocol — each fix follows candidate → ≥3-prevented-incidents → BLOCKER cadence
